title.ja: 第2回調停期日も不成立
title.en: Second mediation session also ends without agreement

summary.ja: 専属契約有効確認訴訟の第2回調停期日が開かれたが合意に至らず、判決言い渡しは10月30日に予定された。
summary.en: The second mediation session in the contract-validity suit ended without agreement; the ruling was scheduled for October 30.

editor_note: Details of the 09-11 session (attendance, duration) not reported; date per Herald/Wikipedia. | Session details still unreported; Herald Business piece (2025-10-29) confirms two failed mediations in August and September.

detail.ja: 2025年9月11日、ソウル中央地方裁判所民事合議41部（チョン・フェイル部長判事）で、ADORがNewJeansのメンバー5人を相手に提起した専属契約有効確認訴訟の第2回調停期日が開かれたが、8月14日の第1回に続き合意に至らなかった。裁判所は8月の時点で、調停が不成立の場合は10月30日に判決を言い渡すと予告しており、ヘラルド経済は判決言い渡しを10月30日9時50分と伝えている。争点はメンバーが主張する信頼関係の破綻の有無で、ADORは忠実に支援してきたとして解除事由はないと主張していた。出席者や所要時間は報道されていない。
detail.en: On September 11, 2025 the Seoul Central District Court's Civil Division 41 (presiding judge Jung Hoe-il) held the second mediation session in ADOR's contract-validity suit against the five NewJeans members, which, like the first session on August 14, ended without agreement. The court had said in August that it would deliver judgment on October 30 if mediation failed, and The Herald Business reported the pronouncement scheduled for 9:50 am that day. The central issue was whether the breakdown of trust claimed by the members had occurred, with ADOR maintaining that it had faithfully supported them and that there were no grounds for termination. Attendance and duration of the session were not reported.

credits.court: Seoul Central District Court, Civil Division 41 (presiding judge Jung Hoe-il)

title.ja: 1審判決：ADORとの専属契約は有効
title.en: First-instance ruling: exclusive contracts with ADOR remain valid

summary.ja: ソウル中央地裁民事合議41部は、ミン・ヒジンの解任のみでは契約解除事由にならないとしてADOR勝訴の判決を言い渡し、メンバー側代理人は即時控訴の意向を示した。
summary.en: The Seoul Central District Court (Civil Division 41) ruled for ADOR, holding that Min Hee-jin's dismissal alone was no ground for termination; the members' counsel said they would appeal immediately.

note: ADORは「NewJeansを待ち続ける」との立場を示した。
editor_note: Ruling delivered in the morning ('이날 오전'); exact time not confirmed. Contracts run to 2029-07-31 per ADOR.

detail.ja: 2025年10月30日午前、ソウル中央地方裁判所民事合議41部（チョン・フェイル部長判事）は、ADORがNewJeansのメンバー5人を相手に提起した専属契約有効確認訴訟で原告ADOR勝訴の判決を言い渡し、専属契約が依然として有効であると認めた。裁判所はADORが企画会社としての義務に違反したとは認められないとし、ミン・ヒジン前代表の解任が契約違反にあたるという主張と信頼関係の破綻を理由とする解除の主張をいずれも退け、「信頼関係破綻の外観を作って専属契約から逃れようとする試みは許されるべきでない」と述べた。ADORは契約が有効と認められたことに感謝し、企画会社としての役割を省み、正規アルバムの発売など活動の準備を終えて待っているとし、アーティストとともにファンのもとへ戻ると表明した。メンバー5人は控訴する意向を示した。
detail.en: On the morning of October 30, 2025 the Seoul Central District Court's Civil Division 41 (presiding judge Jung Hoe-il) ruled for the plaintiff ADOR in its contract-validity suit against the five NewJeans members, holding that the exclusive contracts remain valid. The court found that ADOR had not breached its obligations as the management company, rejected both the argument that former CEO Min Hee-jin's dismissal breached the contract and the claim of termination for breakdown of trust, and said that attempts to escape an exclusive contract by manufacturing the appearance of broken trust should not be permitted. ADOR thanked the court for confirming the contracts remain valid, said it would reflect on its role as a management company, said it had completed preparations for activities including a full-length album and was waiting, and pledged to bring the artists back to fans. The five members indicated they would appeal.

credits.court: Seoul Central District Court, Civil Division 41 (presiding judge Jung Hoe-il)

title.ja: ADOR、ヘリンとヘインの復帰を発表
title.en: ADOR announces Haerin and Hyein will return

summary.ja: ADORはプレスリリースで、ヘリンとヘインが家族と熟考しADORと十分に協議した末、判決を尊重し専属契約を遵守すると決めたと発表した。
summary.en: In a press release ADOR said Haerin and Hyein, after careful deliberation with their families and talks with ADOR, decided to respect the ruling and honor their contracts.

editor_note: Issued in the afternoon of 11-12 (Khan 17:38). Exact time not given.

detail.ja: 2025年11月12日午後、ADORはプレスリリースで、ヘリンとヘインがADORと共に活動を続けることで意見をまとめたと発表した。ADORによれば、2人は家族と熟考しADORと十分に協議した末、法院の判決を尊重し専属契約を遵守するという決定を下し、ADORはNewJeansが円滑な芸能活動を続けられるよう最善を尽くすとした。京郷新聞は17時38分に報じており、2024年11月29日の契約解除通告から348日後の発表だった。ADORは10月30日の1審判決後、正規アルバムの発売など活動の準備を終えて待っていると表明していた。
detail.en: On the afternoon of November 12, 2025 ADOR announced in a press release that Haerin and Hyein had agreed to continue their activities with ADOR. According to ADOR, the two members, after careful deliberation with their families and full consultation with ADOR, decided to respect the court's ruling and honor their exclusive contracts, and ADOR said it would do its best so that NewJeans could continue their activities smoothly. The Kyunghyang Shinmun reported it at 17:38, 348 days after the November 29, 2024 termination notice. After the October 30 first-instance ruling ADOR had said it had completed preparations for activities including a full-length album and was waiting.

title.ja: ミンジ・ハニ・ダニエル、代理人を通じて復帰の意思を表明
title.en: Minji, Hanni and Danielle state their intention to return via counsel

summary.ja: ADORの発表から約2時間後、ミンジ・ハニ・ダニエルは法律代理人を通じ、慎重な相談の末ADORに復帰することを決めたと表明し、ADORは「真意を確認中」とした。
summary.en: About two hours after ADOR's announcement, Minji, Hanni and Danielle said through their lawyers that they had decided to return to ADOR; ADOR said it was verifying their intentions.

editor_note: Sorted after the ADOR announcement by slug; reports say it came about two hours later in the afternoon. | Khan reports attribute the statement to the members' legal representative; the law firm is not named in the fetched pages. | note sentences already covered by detail: メンバーの1人が南極にいたため意思の伝達が遅れたと説明した。

detail.ja: 2025年11月12日、ADORがヘリンとヘインの復帰を発表してから約2時間後、ミンジ、ハニ、ダニエルは法律代理人を通じた立場文で、慎重な相談の末ADORに復帰することを決めたと表明した（スポーツ京郷20時08分）。3人は、メンバーの1人が南極にいたため意思疎通が遅れ、ADORからの回答がなかったため別途に立場を伝えることになったと説明し、真心を込めた音楽とステージで会いに行くと述べた。ADOR側は3人の真意を確認中とした。
detail.en: On November 12, 2025, about two hours after ADOR announced the return of Haerin and Hyein, Minji, Hanni and Danielle stated through their legal representative that they had decided to return to ADOR after careful discussion (Sports Kyunghyang, 20:08). The three explained that one member had been in Antarctica, delaying communication, and that because ADOR had not replied they were announcing their position separately, and pledged to return with sincere music and performances. ADOR's side said it was verifying the three members' intentions.

title.ja: 控訴期限が経過、専属契約有効の1審判決が確定
title.en: Appeal deadline passes; first-instance ruling that contracts are valid becomes final

summary.ja: メンバー5人全員が控訴期限の11月14日0時までに控訴状を提出せず、ADORとの専属契約が有効とする1審判決が確定した。
summary.en: None of the five members filed an appeal by the 00:00 November 14 deadline, making the ruling that their contracts with ADOR are valid final.

detail.ja: 2025年11月14日0時の控訴期限までにNewJeansのメンバー5人（ヘリン、ヘイン、ミンジ、ダニエル、ハニ）のいずれも控訴状を提出せず、ソウル中央地方裁判所民事合議41部が10月30日に言い渡した専属契約有効確認の1審判決（ADOR勝訴）が確定した（ヘラルド経済11月13日報道）。11月12日にはヘリンとヘインがADORを通じて、ミンジ、ダニエル、ハニが別途の立場文で復帰を表明しており、ADORはヘリンとヘインが円滑な芸能活動を続けられるよう最善を尽くすとし、ミンジ、ダニエル、ハニについては個別の面談を調整して円滑な協議に努めるとした。
detail.en: By the appeal deadline of midnight on November 14, 2025 none of the five NewJeans members (Haerin, Hyein, Minji, Danielle and Hanni) had filed a notice of appeal, making final the first-instance judgment delivered on October 30 by the Seoul Central District Court's Civil Division 41 confirming the validity of the exclusive contracts in ADOR's favor (The Herald Business, November 13). On November 12 Haerin and Hyein had announced their return through ADOR and Minji, Danielle and Hanni in a separate statement; ADOR said it would do its best so that Haerin and Hyein could continue their activities smoothly and that it was arranging individual meetings with Minji, Danielle and Hanni for smooth discussions.

credits.court: Seoul Central District Court, Civil Division 41 (judgment of October 30, 2025)

title.ja: ADOR、ハニの復帰とダニエルの専属契約解除を発表
title.en: ADOR announces Hanni's return and the termination of Danielle's contract

summary.ja: ADORはハニが判決を尊重しADORと共にすることを決めたと発表する一方、ダニエルには契約違反を理由に専属契約解除を通告し、違約罰・損害賠償を請求するとし、ミンジとは協議を継続中とした。
summary.en: ADOR said Hanni had decided to respect the ruling and stay with ADOR, while it terminated Danielle's contract citing breaches and would seek penalties and damages; talks with Minji were continuing.

note: ADORはダニエルの家族1人と元代表ミン・ヒジンにも法的責任を問うとした。
editor_note: Suit against Danielle and two others: Korean reports say the complaint was to be filed the same day (claim later reported as about 43.1bn won; one report says 33.1bn); English Wikipedia dates the filing 12-30. Not split into a separate record. | Damages amount and filing date of the suit against Danielle's side are not in the Money Today article; left out of reader text.

detail.ja: 2025年12月29日、ADORは専属契約有効確認判決の確定後、ミンジ、ハニ、ダニエルおよびその家族と多くの協議を重ねてきたとした上で、3人に関する立場を発表した。ハニは家族とともに韓国を訪れADORと長時間話し合い、過去を振り返った末に「法院の判決を尊重してADORと共にすることを決めた」とされた。ミンジについては相互理解を深めるための協議が継続中で決定には至っていないとした。ダニエルについては、NewJeansのメンバーでありADOR所属アーティストとして共にすることは難しいと判断したとして同日専属契約の解除を通告し、紛争と離脱、復帰の遅れを招いたとしてダニエルの家族1人とミン・ヒジン前代表に法的責任を問うとした。ADORはメンバーが長期間偏った情報にさらされ誤解が生じたとし、ファンと大衆の信頼回復には正確な事実の共有と時間が必要で、紛争をめぐる論争については後日メンバーが語る場を別途設けると述べ、できるだけ早くNewJeansをファンのもとに戻すよう最善を尽くすとした。
detail.en: On December 29, 2025 ADOR announced its position on Minji, Hanni and Danielle, saying it had held many discussions with the three and their families after the contract-validity ruling became final. Hanni, it said, had visited Korea with her family, held lengthy talks with ADOR and, after reflecting on the past, decided to respect the court's ruling and stay with ADOR. Talks with Minji were continuing to deepen mutual understanding, with no decision yet. ADOR said it had that day notified Danielle of the termination of her exclusive contract, judging it difficult to continue with her as a NewJeans member and ADOR artist, and that it would pursue legal responsibility against one of Danielle's family members and former CEO Min Hee-jin for causing the dispute, the departure and the delayed return. ADOR said the members had long been exposed to distorted information that led to misunderstandings, that restoring the trust of fans and the public would require accurate facts and time, that a separate forum would be arranged later for the members to speak about the controversies, and that it would do its best to bring NewJeans back to fans as soon as possible.

title.ja: ADOR「コペンハーゲン訪問は新たな音楽的叙事のプリプロダクション」
title.en: ADOR: Copenhagen trip was pre-production for a 'new musical narrative'

summary.ja: コペンハーゲンでの目撃情報を受け、ADORはメンバーが各自のコンディションに合わせて活動を準備中で、今後の歩みは最も良い時期に公式に伝えると表明した。
summary.en: Responding to sightings in Copenhagen, ADOR said the members are preparing activities on schedules suited to each of them and that it would announce future plans at the best time.

editor_note: ADOR's statement does not name members; reports say Hanni, Haerin and Hyein were in Copenhagen (mid-April).

detail.ja: 2026年4月27日、ADORはコペンハーゲンでの目撃情報と、ADOR名義で13日から16日まで予約されたとされる現地のレコーディングスタジオのスケジュール表がオンラインコミュニティで出回ったことを受け、立場を発表した（YTN star 11時29分）。ADORは「NewJeansのメンバーは現在、メンバーごとのコンディションと各自に最適化されたスケジュールに従って活動を準備している」とし、「コペンハーゲン訪問はNewJeansの新しい音楽的叙事を盛り込むための事前プロダクション過程の一環だった」と説明し、今後の歩みは最も良い時期に公式に伝えるとした。スタジオ使用の有無については明確にしなかった。報道では4月中旬にヘリン、ヘイン、ハニがコペンハーゲンで目撃されたとされ、当時ヘリン、ヘイン、ハニはADORに復帰済みで、ダニエルは契約解除後に係争中、ミンジは未定だった。
detail.en: On April 27, 2026 ADOR issued a statement after sightings in Copenhagen and the circulation on an online community of what appeared to be a local recording studio's schedule showing bookings under ADOR's name from the 13th to the 16th (YTN star, 11:29). ADOR said the NewJeans members were preparing activities according to each member's condition and a schedule optimized for her, described the Copenhagen visit as part of the pre-production process for a new musical narrative for NewJeans, and said it would officially announce their next steps at the best time. It did not clearly confirm or deny use of a studio. Reports placed Haerin, Hyein and Hanni in Copenhagen in mid-April; at the time those three had returned to ADOR, Danielle was in dispute after her contract was terminated, and Minji's status was undecided.

title.ja: ADOR、ミンジの去就について「全般的に肯定的な方向で協議中」
title.en: ADOR on Minji: talks 'continuing in a generally positive direction'

summary.ja: ミンジの誕生日にADORは、今後の活動について内部で協議を続けており、具体的な立場はないが全般的に肯定的な方向で協議が進んでいると述べた。
summary.en: On Minji's birthday ADOR said internal discussions about her future activities continue and, while it had nothing specific to share, talks were moving in a generally positive direction.

editor_note: The HAPPY MINJI DAY post of the same day is already in tweet.json.

detail.ja: ミンジの誕生日にあたる2026年5月7日、ADORはミンジの復帰に関するエクスポーツニュースの問い合わせに対し、「今後の活動に関して内部的に議論を続けている」とし、「具体的な事項については現在別途に申し上げられる立場はないが、全般的に肯定的な方向で協議が続いている状況と理解してほしい」と答えた（同日10時52分報道）。同日NewJeans公式アカウントにはクッキーを作り包装するミンジの誕生日写真が投稿され、ミンジはファン主催の誕生日カフェを訪れて手書きの手紙やフォトカード、手作りクッキーを配っており、記事はミンジがADORと活動の方向性をめぐり約6か月協議を続けていると伝えた。当時ヘリン、ヘイン、ハニは復帰を確定しており、ダニエルは契約解除の通告を受けていた。
detail.en: On May 7, 2026, Minji's birthday, ADOR told Xportsnews in response to questions about her return that internal discussions about her future activities were continuing, that it had nothing specific to share separately at present, and that talks should be understood as proceeding in a generally positive direction (reported 10:52). The same day the official NewJeans account posted birthday photos of Minji making and packaging cookies, and she had recently visited a fan-organized birthday cafe to hand out handwritten letters, photo cards and homemade cookies; the article said she had been negotiating with ADOR over the direction of her activities for about six months. By then Haerin, Hyein and Hanni had confirmed their return and Danielle had received a contract termination notice.

title.ja: ADOR、『How Sweet』盗作訴訟に「盗作ではない」と反論
title.en: ADOR denies plagiarism after 'How Sweet' copyright suit

summary.ja: 米国で作曲家4人が『How Sweet』がデモ曲「One of a Kind」を盗用したとして提訴したことを受け、ADORは制作陣BANAに確認した結果盗作はないとし、訴訟に対応すると発表した。
summary.en: After four composers sued in the US claiming 'How Sweet' copied their demo 'One of a Kind', ADOR said production team BANA confirmed there was no plagiarism and that it would respond to the suit.

editor_note: Suit reported by Billboard on 05-08 (US time). English Wikipedia says ADOR added on 07-10 that the song was sourced via BANA under Min Hee-jin and that internal records were under review; that later statement is not recorded separately. | Court not named in the Newsis report; ADOR's full statement text not included.

detail.ja: 米Billboardが2026年5月8日（米国時間）、Audrey Amacostら作曲家4人が「How Sweet」は自分たちのデモ「One of a Kind」を盗用したとして、NewJeans、ADOR、HYBEおよびメンバー5人（ミンジ、ハニ、ヘリン、ヘイン、ダニエル）を相手に米国で提訴しロイヤルティを求めていると報じた。原告側は両曲が変ロ短調で拍子が同じで、第1バースのメロディーと構造が量的・質的に類似し、31音のメロディー列がほぼ同一だと主張し、NewJeansにトップラインを提供したが使われなかったとしていた。ニューシスの5月9日の報道によれば、ADORは盗作の主張を「事実無根」とし、当時代表だったミン・ヒジンの総括の下で同曲を制作した外部制作チームBANAが盗作はないと確認したとして、制作陣の立場を尊重して訴訟に対応する方針を示した。「How Sweet」は2024年5月のダブルシングルのタイトル曲で、Billboard Global 200で15位を記録していた。
detail.en: Billboard reported on May 8, 2026 (US time) that four songwriters led by Audrey Amacost had sued NewJeans, ADOR, HYBE and the five members (Minji, Hanni, Haerin, Hyein and Danielle) in the United States, claiming 'How Sweet' copied their demo 'One of a Kind' and seeking royalties. The plaintiffs alleged both songs share the key of B-flat minor and the same meter, that the first-verse melody and structure are quantitatively and qualitatively similar, that a 31-note melodic sequence is nearly identical, and that they had offered NewJeans a topline that was not used. According to Newsis on May 9, ADOR called the plagiarism claim baseless, said the external production team BANA, which had worked on the song under then-CEO Min Hee-jin's supervision, confirmed there was no plagiarism, and indicated it would respond to the suit in line with the producers' position. 'How Sweet' was the title track of the May 2024 double single and had reached No.15 on the Billboard Global 200.

title.ja: デビュー4周年「2026 Summer of NewJeans」公開、ADOR「活動計画は協議終了後に発表」
title.en: 4th anniversary '2026 Summer of NewJeans' released; ADOR says plans will follow once talks conclude

summary.ja: デビュー4周年の0時にミンジ・ハニ・ヘリン・ヘインが出演する「2026 Summer of NewJeans」の映像と写真が公式チャンネルで公開され、ADORは具体的な活動計画と方式は協議が完全に終わった後に発表すると説明した。
summary.en: At midnight on the 4th anniversary, '2026 Summer of NewJeans' videos and photos featuring Minji, Hanni, Haerin and Hyein were posted on official channels; ADOR said specific plans would be announced once discussions are fully concluded.

note: 4人が揃って登場する約2年ぶりの新規コンテンツ。ADORは「ファンと4周年を祝うための記念コンテンツ」と説明した。
editor_note: Official video on the NewJeans channel (ID NNbaTJX_9go; channel crawl shows 'Jul 21, 2026' in US time = 07-22 00:00 KST). Release time 00:00 KST per fnnews/Yonhap. Individual member films also posted.

detail.ja: デビュー4周年の2026年7月22日0時（韓国時間）、NewJeansの公式YouTubeチャンネルに映像「2026 Summer of NewJeans」が公開され、ミンジ、ハニ、ヘリン、ヘインの4人が順に登場して手をつなぎ語り合う内容だった。あわせて各メンバー名を冠したスペシャルフィルムが公式YouTubeに、グループ写真と個人写真が公式SNSに投稿された。ダニエルは含まれていない。グループとしてのコンテンツは2025年3月のComplexCon香港以来約1年4か月ぶりだった。ADORは聯合ニュースに対し、映像は「ファンとともに楽しむために制作した記念コンテンツ」であり、具体的な活動計画と方式は「議論が完全に終わった後に発表する計画」だと説明した。当時ヘリン、ヘイン、ハニは復帰済みで、ミンジについてADORは協議が肯定的に進んでいるとしていた。
detail.en: At midnight KST on July 22, 2026, the group's fourth debut anniversary, the video '2026 Summer of NewJeans' was posted on the official NewJeans YouTube channel, showing Minji, Hanni, Haerin and Hyein appearing in sequence, holding hands and talking with one another. Special films under each member's name were also posted on the official YouTube channel, with group and individual photos on the official social accounts. Danielle was not included. It was the first group content in about a year and four months, since ComplexCon Hong Kong in March 2025. ADOR told Yonhap the video was commemorative content made to enjoy with fans and that specific activity plans and formats would be announced once discussions were fully concluded. At the time Haerin, Hyein and Hanni had returned, and ADOR had said talks with Minji were progressing positively.

title.ja: ダニエル側との損害賠償訴訟の弁論でADOR「活動計画がないわけではない」
title.en: At a hearing in the damages suit, ADOR says 'it is not that there are no activity plans'

summary.ja: ソウル中央地裁でのダニエルらに対する損害賠償訴訟の弁論で、ADOR側は訴訟のため活動再開が遅れることはあっても活動計画自体がないわけではないと述べた。
summary.en: At a hearing in the damages suit against Danielle and others at the Seoul Central District Court, ADOR said the litigation might delay a resumption of activities but that it did have activity plans.

editor_note: Fifth hearing per Star News ('지난 10일'). Latest ADOR remark on activity plans found up to 2026-10-13; no formal 2026 comeback notice located. | MTN (2026-09-10) gives the claim as about 33.1 billion won; other reports cited 43.1 billion.

detail.ja: 2026年9月10日、ソウル中央地方裁判所民事合議31部（ナム・インス部長判事）で、ADORがダニエル、その母親、ミン・ヒジン前代表を相手に約331億ウォンの損害賠償を求める訴訟の第5回弁論が開かれ、主に鑑定資料の閲覧方法など手続き上の争点が扱われた。損害は2024年11月29日の解除通告を基準とする1年間の逸失利益として算定され、鑑定が進行中だった。ダニエル側はメンバーが復帰を表明してから約1年近く具体的な活動がないのは信義則違反になり得るとしてADORに活動正常化の計画の提出を求め、ADOR側は活動計画はプロモーション過程を経て発表されるもので先に計画を要求するのは筋が通らないとし、ダニエルの不在で活動が遅れた可能性は認めつつ「復帰プランなしに戻ってきているはずがない」と述べた。ADORは被告が同業であることを理由に鑑定資料の原本提供に反対し、裁判所は会計士の立会いの下で閲覧する案を提示した。裁判所はまた、解除宣言後に予定された活動を続けたことの法的評価や、HYBE傘下の別グループによる盗作疑惑やレーベル職員の挨拶拒否疑惑を本件で別個の争点として扱うべきかを双方に確認するよう求めた。次回期日は10月22日。
detail.en: On September 10, 2026 the Seoul Central District Court's Civil Division 31 (presiding judge Nam In-su) held the fifth hearing in ADOR's damages suit of about 33.1 billion won against Danielle, her mother and former CEO Min Hee-jin, dealing mainly with procedural questions such as how the appraisal materials should be reviewed. Damages were being calculated as one year of lost profit from the November 29, 2024 termination notice, with an appraisal under way. Danielle's side asked ADOR to submit a plan for normalizing NewJeans' activities, arguing that the absence of concrete activity nearly a year after the members declared their return could breach the principle of good faith; ADOR's side said activity plans would be announced through a promotion process so demanding them first was illogical, and while acknowledging Danielle's absence may have delayed activities, said it was implausible that the group had returned without a plan. ADOR opposed handing over original appraisal materials because the defendants work in the same industry, and the court proposed a review with an accountant present. The court also asked both sides to address whether continuing scheduled activities after declaring termination counted as refusal of performance, and whether alleged plagiarism by another HYBE group and a label employee's alleged refusal to greet a member should be treated as separate issues. The next hearing was set for October 22.

credits.court: Seoul Central District Court, Civil Division 31 (presiding judge Nam In-su)
